guidance.statement: AURIC Phase 1 to go live later this calendar year, adding 5 lakh units annual capacity
Commodity headwind of another 100-200 bps expected, largely manageable with price hikes
EL scooter AtherStack Pro attach rate guided at least 75%

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Automobile and Auto Components > Automobiles > 2/3 Wheelers

operating_notes.text: FY26 COGS per unit fell 9% YoY to ₹1,10,199, lifting adjusted gross margin to 24% from 19%.
Q4FY26 market share was 18.6% (excluding Telangana for Mar'26), up 1,100 bps from Q1FY25.
Factory 3.0 at AURIC will have 10 lakh units a year, with Phase-I (5 lakh) commencing in Q3FY27.
Q4 FY26 Pro-Pack attach rate reached an all-time high of 93%.
Rizta crossed 3 lakh unit sales milestone within two years of launch, accounting for 76% of FY26 sales.
Incorporated wholly owned subsidiary Ather Insurance Limited for corporate agent business.
Wholesale volume grew 81% YoY to 83,000 units in Q1FY27, with registrations up 102% to over 90,000 units.
Adjusted gross margin fell to 22.4% in Q1FY27 from 25.4% in Q4FY26 due to a 46% rise in commodity index over five quarters.
Dealer inventory fell to 3 days from 14 days; management estimates 13,000-15,000 units of unmet monthly demand.
Consolidated results include Ather Insurance Limited and Ather Energy Hong Kong Limited from their respective incorporation dates.
Approved ₹122 Cr capex to expand Hosur capacity by 75,000 units and Factory 3.0 capacity by 150,000 units.
Q2FY27 consolidated results include Ather Insurance Limited and Ather Energy Hong Kong Limited from incorporation.
